title: Row Prefix as Packed Fields
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number and let $w$ assign a finite Boolean word to each of the $l$ coordinates. For every natural number $j\le l$, the stored row prefix of length $j$ equals the packed encoding of the first $j$ words in coordinate order.
hypotheses_covered: family $w$ of Boolean words indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(l)$
replaced: For every family of counter words on $l$ coordinates and every $j \le l$, the stored row prefix of the first $j$ fields equals the packed encoding of the first $j$ words taken in the fixed tape order.
